svg.title: SGLang server with three processes
svg.desc: The main process runs the FastAPI app and the TokenizerManager. The scheduler process runs the scheduler, the tree cache, the memory pools and the model worker on the GPU. The detokenizer process turns token IDs into text. Messages go around a ZMQ ring: tokenizer to scheduler, scheduler to detokenizer, detokenizer to tokenizer.
